spec.evaluation_start_condition: The 240-session live clock starts on the first session after a verified NCCPL primary MTS source has delivered 5 consecutive sessions with sequentially advancing internal report dates and zero parse rejections. No calendar date is pre-committed; postponement carries zero cost and zero peeking.
spec.power_statement: Under sector-matched placebo matching Q5's exact composition (5 Banks, 2 E&P, 2 Cement, 1 OMC, 1 Power, 1 Fertilizer; sigma ~0.626%), T=240 sessions yields 10-day Simulated MDE of 1.400% (20-draw median) at 80% power (Analytic MDE 1.226%). Power at 1.0% 10-day spread is ~52.4% under empirical fat tails. If null cannot be rejected, conclusion is: 'No crowding effect larger than 1.40% per 10 sessions detected'.

signal.rank: cross-sectional over financed names (L>0), average ties
signal.vanished_symbols: excluded and logged to mts_anomalies (not zero-filled)

universe.eligible: PSX_LIQUID_PROXY_139 (fixed 139 symbols meeting session>=190, vol>=50k, close>=10, plus core MTS). Locked for entire evaluation; no mid-run universe substitution.

timing.rule: cohort dropped if captured_at >= entry open

valuation.corporate_actions_rule: All corporate actions derived from Exchange LDCP gap detection (prev_close - ldcp) and ratio analysis. Pipeline halts if ex-suffix or LDCP gap occurs without matching event in corporate_actions.

portfolio.trapped_cash: idle in sleeve until next rebalance

secondary: PT MR test decreasing across financed buckets Q1..Q5, B=10000, block=10
Sector-Neutral Crowding Spread: within-sector mean(Q5 - sector_universe)

sector_neutral_spread_formula.definition: S_t = sum_{s in S} (N_{Q5, s} / |Q5|) * (R_{Q5, s, t} - R_{U, s, t})
sector_neutral_spread_formula.eligible_universe_in_sector: R_{U, s, t} includes all eligible stocks in sector s (including Q5 members)
sector_neutral_spread_formula.monopoly_sector_rule: If sector s contains only Q5 stocks in eligible universe, spread for sector s is set to 0
sector_neutral_spread_formula.execution: Computed via identical JT sleeve engine with sector-filtered schedules

interpretation_gate.rule: Crowding effect confirmed ONLY IF primary test is statistically significant (p < 0.025) AND sector-neutral spread mean < 0. If primary is significant but sector-neutral spread >= 0, result is classified as Sector Exposure (e.g. macro banking drag).
interpretation_gate.null_framing: Failure to reject implies no crowding effect larger than 1.40% per 10 sessions detected.

operational_rules.degradation_label: DEGRADED if missing cohort sessions exceed 10%

Zero peeking, zero cost for postponement.
